description: CHP-TEMP-006 — temporal negative conformance vectors. Each case is one a conformant implementation MUST reject (stale evidence, revocation-after-admission, overlapping clock uncertainty, grant overrun). Executed by packages/python/tests/test_temporal.py against the chp_core temporal kernel.

vectors.note: evidence well inside no declared window is still stale once older than the policy max-age
a later revocation MUST NOT rewrite the earlier record; re-evaluation produces a NEW record
two readings whose uncertainty windows overlap cannot be strictly ordered
a grant whose valid_until is past a depended-on validity bound outlives its authority
